'''Stephen Dennis Atwater''' (born October 28, 1966) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who was a [[Safety (American football position)|safety]] for the [[Denver Broncos]] of the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He was an eight-time [[Pro Bowl]] selection and two-time [[Super Bowl]] champion. Atwater was elected to the [[Pro Football Hall of Fame]] on February 1, 2020.

Atwater and [[Dennis Smith (American football)|Dennis Smith]] made up a Broncos secondary that was known for their ferocious hits on opposing players.

'''Steven Joseph Bartkowski''' (born November 12, 1952) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who was a [[quarterback]] in the [[National Football League]] (NFL) for the [[Atlanta Falcons]] (1975–1985), [[Washington Commanders|Washington Redskins]] (1985) and the [[Los Angeles Rams]] (1986). He was a two-time [[Pro Bowl]] selection. Bartkowski played [[college football]] for the [[California Golden Bears football|California Golden Bears]], earning consensus [[College Football All-America Team|All-American]] honors as a [[senior (education)|senior]] in 1974. He was selected by the Falcons with the [[List of first overall National Football League draft picks|first overall pick]] of the [[1975 NFL draft]].

'''Steven Jack Bush'''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pro-football-reference.com/players/B/BushSt00.htm |title=Steve Bush |website=Pro Football Reference |publisher=Sports Reference |access-date=January 4, 2023}}</ref> (born July 4, 1974) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] [[tight end]] and [[fullback (American football)|fullback]] in the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He went to [[Arizona State University]].

Bush was signed as an [[undrafted free agent]] by the [[Cincinnati Bengals]] in 1997. After several years with the team playing mostly on [[special teams]], he was signed by the [[St. Louis Rams]] during the 2001 offseason, but was cut before the end of training camp. He was then picked up by the [[Arizona Cardinals]], where he played at both [[tight end]] and special teams. After being released by the Cardinals before the start of the [[2004 NFL season|2004 season]], he was signed by the 49ers in December 2004. As a member of the 49ers, he has seen starting time as both fullback and tight end, and has been a boost on special teams, providing key blocks for the return men.
